title: Adidas Freerider MTB Shoes Get Stripes
content:
Today, Adidas unveils the next generation of its Freerider mountain bike shoes, featuring Pro Boa Flat and Pro Boa Clipless models. And with new stripes, the iconic brand is known for…

The Freerider debuted in 2009 with its Stealth rubber construction being lauded by professional racers and novices alike. The arrival of the Five Ten Hellcat clipless model soon followed, and by 2010 the shoe had already been fully welcomed by the cultural zeitgeist. Then, in 2011, Five Ten and adidas joined forces.

Now, the next wave of Adidas mountain bike shoes brings together these defining franchises, uniting Five Ten’s shoe designs’ grip, fit, and off-the-bike style with the Hellcat clip-in performance. The Freerider will be available as a laced flat pedal version, Pro Boa flat pedal, and Pro Boa Clipless.

The new Freerider range starts at €120 / $120, with the Freerider Pro Boa and the Freerider Pro Boa Clipless priced at €180/$180 and €250/$250 respectively. Available to buy at adidas.com and via the adidas app from March 2027.

See more at Adidas.
